class_imbalance._comment: tau is SEARCHED in [0.05, 0.8]. tau=1.0, the parameter-free default, over-corrects at this imbalance: dev fold 2 single-task `feature` scored 0.009 at tau=1.0 against 0.484 at tau=0.25.
class_imbalance._selected_by: grouped Optuna search over the dev folds

_provenance.selection: single Optuna search over all of train, dev folds as inner CV
_provenance.why: per-outer-fold hyperparameters would be selected on fold difficulty; fold 4 scored 0.453 against 0.154-0.238 because it had 98.8 % in-vocabulary coverage and a 75.3 % majority class
_provenance.refit_reason: Second refit attempt. Identical to configs/final_grouped_v9/multitask.json (BioProject-grouped early-stopping split, hyperparameters inherited unchanged from the published v9 configs, seed 42) except that early stopping tracks the mean macro-F1 over classification heads instead of the validation loss. The loss rule produced underfit models: community_type saved epoch 0 at val_acc 0.5896 where epoch 2 reached 0.7689, and train f1_macro_eligible fell from 0.9677 to 0.4318. Rule fixed before this ran and applied identically to all five arms; headline metric unchanged; no held-out read taken.
